validator.source_text:
<?ui-args --schema urn:example:action=tests/ui/schemas/action.xsd?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:x="urn:example:action" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <x:notify chanel="ops" message="started"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

notes: the schema registered for `urn:example:action` rejects this under XML Schema constraint `cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`: Attribute 'chanel' is not allowed for this element
spec_references: XML Schema 1.0 Part 1 §3.4.4 Element Locally Valid (Complex Type) (`cvc-complex-type.3.2.2`)

fixes.message: `<x:notify>` has an attribute with a similar name: `channel`
